{{Top}}
[[File:Qui-GonBurning-TPM.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[Jedi funeral/Legends|cremation]] of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]]]
'''Cremation''' was one of the procedures used throughout most of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to dispose of the remains of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] creatures. Speculatively, this was done due to the incredible population (both past and present) of the galaxy and the resulting lack of space available for burials. There may also have been cultural and religious reasons that sentient beings chose cremation. For example, the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] thought that a corpse had to be cremated within two days time in order to return the deceased's spirit to the planet.

Cremation usually took the form of a solemn [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] pyre, with the deceased individual's friends and family observing the process. On battlefields and similar locations where large numbers of sentients died, the bodies were often piled and burnt en masse for expediency, but the process was still done solemnly and with as much respect as possible.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Imperial control of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] made it difficult to return the bodies of Corellians who died away from their homeworld. Deceased Corellian exiles were often cremated, and the [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] residue was compressed into synthetic [[Diamond/Legends|diamonds]]. These diamonds were then taken to the [[Corellian Sanctuary]] which was established after the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] took possession of the world. But during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] the Sanctuary was vandalized by Alliance supporters.

A popular alternative to cremation was [[Burial/Legends|burial]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] left no corpses when they died, instead becoming "one with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]". [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] may also have become one with the Force, but sources are unclear. When [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] died, she left her body behind. One week later during her [[Funeral of Mara Jade Skywalker|funeral]] her remains were set on a cremation pyre, with the intention that they would be cremated at the conclusion of the service - however Mara chose to return her body to the Force during the ceremony, as a means to hint at the identity of [[Darth Caedus|the person]] who murdered her.

==Culture==
When [[Ke Daiv]]'s deceased body was struck by laser cannon fire, it was described as "his ritual cremation", possibly signifying that cremation was a ritual among [[Blood Carver]]s.<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Examples of cremation in the ''Star Wars'' films:
*In [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|Episode I]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] body is cremated on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], with many members of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] in attendance.
*In [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|Episode IV]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] cremate the bodies of a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] clan that have been slaughtered by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].
*In [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|Episode VI]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] erects a funeral pyre for his father [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. It used to be a matter of some debate whether Luke cremated his father's body, or just his armor, but it has been stated that Anakin's body disappeared and that it was just the armor that Luke cremated.

Examples of cremation in the Expanded Universe:
*When the Wookiee Jedi Master known as [[Tyvokka/Legends|Tyvokka]] was shot three times by Battle Droids, he was bought aboard a cruiser, where he later died from his injuries. The cruiser then sustained heavy blaster fire, which caused it to crash land and explode, with Tyvokka's body still onboard. His Padawan, [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], was devastated by this, but [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] comforted him by pointed out that the burning wreckage of the ship served as a makeshift funeral pyre for the late Jedi Master.<ref name="shw3">[[Star Wars (1998) 38|''Star Wars'' (1998) 38]]</ref>
*In ''[[Rogue Planet]]'', when Ke Daiv died, his body was later hit by Laser Cannon fire directed at Obi-Wan, cremating his body.
*After [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]] died as a result of being stabbed by [[Ashaar Khorda]] and using his remaining energy to bind the power within the [[Infant of Shaa]] during the [[Skirmish at Coruscant's power core]], his body was cremated with fire during a Jedi funeral, which many other Jedi attended.<ref name="ZamWesell">''[[Star Wars: Zam Wesell]]''</ref>
*The Clone Trooper Commander known as [[Faie/Legends|Faie]] was killed by the Jedi Master [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] on Kashyyyk, and [[Vilmarh Grahrk]] then cremated Faie's body atop with fire atop a wooden pyre. Several more Clone Troopers then arrived on the scene, and Grahrk told them that it was Vos who had been killed and whose body was burning, with this lie allowing Vos time to escape.<ref name="Republic 83">[[Republic 83|''Republic'' 83]]</ref>
*When the monk known as Brother [[Mabob]], who was a member of the [[Ancient Order of Pessimists]], was killed by [[Abal Karda]] on [[Maryx Minor]], he was given the proper funeral of the Ancient Order, in which his body was cremated by being dropped into a pit of lava.<ref name="EOTE3">[[Boba Fett: Enemy of the Empire 3|''Boba Fett: Enemy of the Empire'' 3]]</ref>
*The grocer known as [[Gates Harnik]] was hung from damaged scaffolding in the ruins of the town of [[Tamarack]] on [[Cilpar]], and his body was later cut down by the members of the [[Cilpari Resistance]], who expressed regret over his death. The Cilpari Resistance member known as [[Chang]] then cremated Harnik's body with a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] in order to prevent [[Ronk/Legends|ronks]] from eating it.<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 1">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 1|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 1]]</ref>
*[[Trioculus]] was killed by being shot in the chest by a [[Human replica droid]] resembling [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and his body was subsequently cremated with fire in a cremation chamber onboard the [[Moffship]] during a ceremony held before the ship's officers and crew. His ashes were placed into four separate cannisters, which were then each loaded onto four separate Imperial missile probes. The probes were then each launched in a different direction to the furthest reaches of the galaxy.<ref name="Prophets of the Dark Side">[[Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)|''Prophets of the Dark Side'']]</ref>
*After the body of [[Anakin Solo]] was recovered by his sister, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] cremated Anakin's body following a memorial service on Hapes in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''.
*In ''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]'', the Yuuzhan Vong appear to cremate their dead.
